startingInstruction.title: Starting instruction

about.ATTACK: A more open game: more goals at both ends.
about.BALANCED: Neither more open nor tighter: the two elevens' strength decides.
about.DEFEND: A tighter game: fewer goals at both ends.

startingInstruction.principle: Stronger than your opponent: open the game up; weaker: shut it down.
startingInstruction.assistant: It holds from kick-off, then your assistant adapts it to the score: attack when behind from the 60th minute, sit back one goal up from the 75th.
